description: Buffered dispatch streams upstream. Today `dispatch_attempts_under_permit` (router.rs ~4262-4270) always sends `stream:false`. Every streaming client request also lands there, because the Codex Search gate (router.rs ~8738) forces buffering. Electron Hub returns HTTP 504 ~100 s into such requests, and the header-only TTFB (router.rs ~4577) caps Nano-GPT/NIM generations at 120 s. Send `stream:true` (+ `stream_options.include_usage`) and reassemble internally, with TTFB covering headers plus the first body chunk and an inter-chunk idle timeout. Add a per-provider opt-out `buffered_upstream_streaming` with admin-panel parity. Preserve full usage in SSE reassembly and harden SSE detection/truncation. Implements plan.md items 1-6 and design decisions DD1-DD6 and DD13. Depends on nothing; FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 build on it.
steps: Item 1: add `buffered_upstream_streaming: Option<bool>` (#[serde(default)], doc comment) to `Provider` in crates/ai-gateway/src/config/mod.rs, plus `effective_buffered_upstream_streaming()` (unwrap_or(provider_type != "bedrock")) and config unit tests. Add `GatewayError::ChunkTimeout(u64)` ("Provider stopped sending data for {0}s", GATEWAY_TIMEOUT) in crates/ai-gateway/src/error/mod.rs and handle it in every exhaustive match (handlers.rs IntoResponse ~1163, classify_stream_error ~4289, using the relay's inter-chunk timeout SSE error type). Add `buffered_upstream_streaming: None` to every `Provider {..}` literal (search `ttfb_timeout_seconds:` in src/ and tests/, ~34 sites).

Item 2: in Router::reassemble_sse_response (router.rs ~5169-5415), keep the last usage frame as a full `Usage` (extras such as prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens and completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens), keeping the token estimate only when no usage arrived. Return Err("Upstream stream ended before completion") when there is no [DONE] and no finish_reason. Add `body_looks_like_sse()` (skip blank, ':' comment, event:/id:/retry: lines; first remaining line starts with 'data:') and use it in place of `body_text.starts_with("data: ")` (~4818). Tests: reassemble_sse_response_preserves_usage_details, buffered_sse_without_done_or_finish_reason_is_truncation_error, buffered_sse_with_leading_comment_lines_is_reassembled.

Item 3: add a private async `read_upstream_body(response, first_byte_deadline, idle: Option<Duration>, total_deadline)` reader over `response.bytes_stream()` in router.rs: TtfbTimeout before the first chunk, ChunkTimeout on an idle gap, TotalTimeout past the total deadline, Provider error on a stream error. Unit tests build reqwest::Response from a delayed stream, like `stalling_streaming_response` in handlers.rs tests ~6931: buffered_sse_reader_ttfb_covers_first_body_chunk, buffered_sse_reader_allows_generation_longer_than_ttfb_when_bytes_flow (KEY regression guard), buffered_sse_reader_idle_gap_is_chunk_timeout, buffered_sse_reader_total_timeout.

Item 4: in dispatch_attempts_under_permit, compute `stream_upstream = provider_cfg.effective_buffered_upstream_streaming() && !requires_non_streaming(&outgoing)` (n>1, logprobs/top_logprobs, audio modalities stay stream:false). Set outgoing.stream accordingly. Insert stream_options.include_usage only if absent, before sanitize_request_for_provider. On success status with stream_upstream, read the body with the item 3 reader (first byte = request_start+ttfb, idle = streaming.chunk_timeout_seconds or its StreamingConfig default, total = request_start+total). Otherwise keep response.text() exactly as today. Error statuses keep response.text(). Add the one-shot fallback: a 400 whose body mentions stream_options/stream → retry the same provider once with stream:false and without the gateway-inserted stream_options, skipping backoff, with a warn suggesting buffered_upstream_streaming:false. SSE mid-stream error frames follow error-in-200 semantics (rate-limit-shaped → 429 cooldown path; else retryable). Tests (wiremock): buffered_dispatch_requests_upstream_stream_and_reassembles_sse, buffered_dispatch_accepts_json_body_when_provider_ignores_stream_true, buffered_upstream_streaming_disabled_sends_stream_false, buffered_dispatch_keeps_stream_false_for_multi_choice_or_logprobs, buffered_dispatch_falls_back_to_stream_false_when_stream_options_rejected.

Item 5: admin parity. Add a 'Stream upstream for buffered requests' checkbox (class prov-buffered-upstream-streaming) to the provider card markup in crates/ai-gateway/src/admin/static/index.html. Load it near the .prov-ttfb-timeout load (~2977): checked when null/true. Save it in the providers save literal near ttfb_timeout_seconds (~4083). Add the field to the Provider literals in crates/ai-gateway/src/admin/mod.rs (~2150, ~2718). Add an admin config round-trip test in the admin/mod.rs tests.
Item 6: run the clean-build gate and the lib tests; record results in findings.

A generation whose bytes keep flowing for longer than ttfb_timeout succeeds; TTFB fires only when no body byte arrives in time (buffered_sse_reader_* tests pass).
Usage details (cached_tokens, reasoning_tokens) survive reassembly, and gateway cache/reasoning extras are populated.
buffered_upstream_streaming: false restores stream:false with today's semantics; Bedrock/Codex paths are untouched.
The admin panel shows and saves the new provider option (admin round-trip test passes).
cargo check -p ai-gateway --all-targets reports 0 warnings; cargo test -p ai-gateway --lib passes; the listed JSON-mock integration binaries still pass.

ERROR: `GatewayError::ChunkTimeout(u64)`, Display "Provider stopped sending data for {0}s", status_code() GATEWAY_TIMEOUT. handlers.rs IntoResponse maps it to 504 with type `chunk_timeout_error`. `classify_stream_error` has a direct arm (`chunk_timeout_error`, "Provider stopped sending data for {secs}s"), and the AllProvidersFailed branch matches the attempt-error signature "stopped sending data" (CHUNK_SIGNATURE). error/mod.rs has a wildcard arm, so no other exhaustive matches needed changes.

ROUTER (router.rs). Module-level private items next to the `use super::{CircuitBreaker..}` line near the top:
- `const SSE_TRUNCATED_ERROR: &str = "Upstream stream ended before completion"`
- `struct SseReassembly { response: OpenAIResponse, completed: bool }`
- `enum SseReassemblyError { NoChunks, ErrorFrame { message: String, frame: String }, ErrorFinish(String) }` (implements Display)
- `fn body_looks_like_sse(body: &str) -> bool`
- `fn requires_non_streaming(request: &OpenAIRequest) -> bool`: n>1, logprobs/top_logprobs set, audio, or modalities containing audio
- `struct UpstreamBodyLimits { first_byte_deadline: tokio::time::Instant, ttfb_secs: u64, idle: Option<Duration>, total_deadline: tokio::time::Instant, total_secs: u64 }`
- `async fn read_upstream_body(response: reqwest::Response, limits: &UpstreamBodyLimits, provider_name: &str) -> Result<String, GatewayError>`. It returns TtfbTimeout(ttfb_secs), ChunkTimeout(idle.as_secs()), TotalTimeout(total_secs), or Provider{"Failed to read response body: ..", Some(response status)}.

Router impl methods:
- `fn reassemble_sse_stream(body) -> Result<SseReassembly, SseReassemblyError>` is the real implementation. `pub(crate) fn reassemble_sse_response(body) -> Result<OpenAIResponse, String>` keeps its signature and error strings and wraps it.
- `fn sse_data_payloads(body) -> Vec<&str>` parses line by line, accepts `data:` with or without the space, skips comment/event/id/retry lines, and splits a data line on `data: ` only when it is not one valid JSON value.
- `fn is_stream_param_rejection(body) -> bool`
- `async fn cool_down_rate_limited_200(&self, provider_name, &HeaderMap, body, err_msg) -> GatewayError`. This was extracted from the existing error-in-200 rate-limit block, which now calls it; the SSE error-frame path uses it too.

DEVIATION FROM PLAN ITEM 2: the 'no [DONE] and no finish_reason -> Err' check is NOT inside `reassemble_sse_response`. Its other callers (guardrail/stream.rs assemble with its `complete` flag, the handlers.rs relay cache/usage at ~5031, tool_compression/middleware.rs) need partial bodies to keep returning Ok. Instead `SseReassembly.completed` carries the result, and only the buffered dispatch turns `!completed` into a retryable `Provider{SSE_TRUNCATED_ERROR, Some(status)}` (`continue`). DD6: the last `usage` object is deserialized whole into `Usage`, so `extra` such as prompt_tokens_details/completion_tokens_details is kept. `usage: null` is skipped. Tokens are estimated only when total_tokens==0, and completion_tokens is estimated only when it is 0.

DISPATCH_ATTEMPTS_UNDER_PERMIT:
- `chunk_timeout_secs` is read from `config.streaming` (falls back to StreamingConfig::default(), 60 s) before `drop(config)`.
- `let mut stream_upstream = provider_cfg.effective_buffered_upstream_streaming() && !requires_non_streaming(&outgoing);` is computed right after `outgoing.model = ...`, where the old `outgoing.stream = false` was. Then `outgoing.stream = stream_upstream`.
- `let inserted_stream_options` is true when the gateway added `stream_options:{include_usage:true}` (only when absent). This happens before reasoning_compat and `sanitize_request_for_provider`. NIM's allowlist strips it, so NIM gets stream:true without include_usage, and the 'Sanitized request' info log now fires on every NIM request.
- One-shot flag `stream_fallback_done`, declared next to `image_strip_retry_done`.
- In the retry loop, `body_result` takes one of two paths. When `stream_upstream && status.is_success()` it uses `read_upstream_body` with limits based on `tokio::time::Instant::from_std(request_start)` (+ttfb, idle=chunk_timeout_secs, +total). A reader error is logged and stored in `last_error`, then `continue`. Otherwise it uses the unchanged `tokio::time::timeout(remaining_total, response.text())`.
- The 'Provider responded' info log now includes `stream_upstream` and `elapsed_ms`.
- The SSE branch uses `body_looks_like_sse` and `reassemble_sse_stream`. A completed stream returns Ok with the existing gateway_tool_hint_injected/gateway_reasoning_compat_actions annotations. A stream that is not completed is retryable (continue). An ErrorFrame where `is_rate_limited(200, frame)` goes through cool_down_rate_limited_200 and returns Err 429. Any other ErrorFrame/ErrorFinish becomes a retryable Provider{"Error in 200 response: .."}. NoChunks returns Err("Failed to parse response: ..") as before.
- DD4: the first check in the 4xx branch is `stream_upstream && !stream_fallback_done && status==400 && is_stream_param_rejection(body)`. On a match it sets stream_upstream=false and outgoing.stream=false, removes stream_options if the gateway added it, sets skip_next_backoff, logs a warn recommending `buffered_upstream_streaming: false`, sets last_error, and does `continue`. Like the image-strip retry, this uses one iteration of `max_retries_per_provider`. With max_retries_per_provider=0, the fallback cannot retry and the provider fails over.

FEAT-002 hook points for recording attempts: the reader Err arm (classes ttfb/chunk/total timeout, body_read_error), the `!completed` arm (stream_truncated), the SSE ErrorFrame/ErrorFinish arms (error_in_200), and the DD4 fallback (upstream_http_400).
